original_method: Preserve baseline; validate POR or approved non-POR mirror topology, capacity/address mapping and injector unlock through CE steps1-6; apply exact multi-device masks; inject persistent UCE at0x100000000 with oneInjection=False; verify B2CMI status/address/misc including mirrorfailover, mccmdmirrregion and bankindex; confirm halted pre-go ddr4chnlfailed=0; go once; verify primary ddr4chnlfailed=1 and secondary buddychnlfailed=1; collect health and recover through the approved path.
manual_activity: Intel-qualified owner/FAE approves the persistent UCE/failover recipe, mapping and field values, controls injection/go and recovers or isolates the failed channel while the agent correlates evidence.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The persistent-UCE procedure and criteria consistently target mirror-scrub failure followed by primary-to-secondary channel failover.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The required harness, platform mapping and recovery approval are supplyable RPUC inputs, not an inherent source impossibility.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row166 Wistron-System RAS-00493-V003: approve GNR/BIOS/BMC/OS, DIMM POR or documented non-POR population, CScripts version/hash/license and exact CE-recipe dependency; provide address0x100000000 primary/secondary MC/B2CMI mapping, persistent multi-device mask semantics, expected status/misc fields, pre-go ddr4chnlfailed=0 and post-go primary ddr4chnlfailed=1/secondary buddychnlfailed=1 oracle, plus degraded-channel OOB recovery/restoration.

review_improvement: Makes persistent mode and the two-sided failover transition the acceptance core, prevents generic logs from masking missing register evidence and bounds recovery from an intentionally degraded memory channel.
independent_technical_reasoning: `oneInjection=False` makes this materially different from a transient mirrored UCE: mirror scrub reencounters the fault, so correction cannot complete and failover must be recorded. The halted pre-go zero proves the transition was not preexisting; the primary and secondary bits after go prove directionality. B2CMI address/bank mapping is necessary to attribute the transition to the selected channel. Repeating the fault would obscure the state machine and compound degradation.
